hooks.text: 连续七天用血下注掷骰，每天规则都会改变
hooks.excerpt: Gamble your life away — build a deck of dice and roll to survive seven days of high-stakes sessions. Sounds simple, but the rules change every day.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 允许作弊，以高风险高回报掷骰决定生死
hooks.excerpt: Cheating is allowed, she’s okay with that. Raise the stakes with high-risk, high-reward rolls that can mean the difference between life and death.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 用硬币购买止血包、重掷、食物与护符操控存活概率
hooks.excerpt: Earn coins after every successful session, and purchase items to tilt the odds in your favor — stop the bleeding with emergency health kits, store up re-rolls, eat food to replenish HP levels and equip defensive amulets to build up resolve.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: the voice actress, wow she really nailed it!
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 陷阱选项过多，容易误选无用护符。

excerpts.excerpt: 这游戏的坑人选项太多，稍微不注意就能选到傻逼护符
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 特殊规则更像干扰或直接毁局，而非有趣限制。

excerpts.excerpt: the gimmicks are more of an inconvenience or run killer than an interesting restriction.

excerpts.excerpt: the dice rolls a bit slowly

opinions.text: 缺少令人满意的好结局。

excerpts.excerpt: 还没有好结局，不管是有好感还是没好感，都是死路一条
